messages:
Ethan (Support): handoff: provisioning backlog causing delayed invite emails for several pilots. customers see 'pending activation' despite invites sent. getting 504s from /internal/worker/provision.
Maya (CSM): list of affected accounts? any near-term renewals?
Ethan (Support): GreenBridge (pilot, 80 seats, renewal 2026-10), PaperTrail (trial, 6 seats, trial ends in 9 days), FathomMed (pilot, 40 seats).
Carlos (SE): symptoms? worker queue depth?
Ethan (Support): worker queue spikes then timeouts. logs: `ERROR worker/provision: handler timeout after 120s, depth=450`.
Carlos (SE): likely regression from recent batching change to the provisioner. tagging @pagerbot.
pagerbot: INCIDENT INC-2026-501 opened, priority=P1, owner=@carlos_se. Playbook: provisioner-batch-regress.
Bea (CS Ops): comms plan: 1) notify GreenBridge + FathomMed within 30m, 2) offer manual resend + dedicated onboarding slot, 3) log customer sentiment and propose credit for GreenBridge if they escalate. Maya will lead outreach.
Maya (CSM): will draft messages. For GreenBridge, suggest 1:1 onboarding workshop + 10% one-time credit. Will confirm after Carlos gives ETA.
Carlos (SE): short-term mitigation: throttle batch size to 10 and drain queue; command to run on prod for now: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/provisioner BATCH_SIZE=10` or use internal API `POST /internal/v1/provisioner/config {batch_size:10}`. I'll apply throttle and monitor.
Ethan (Support): please post exact curl for support to trigger manual resend.
Carlos (SE): `curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer TEMP-RESEND\" https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/provisioner/resend_invite -d '{"team_id":"<team>"}'` Token expires in 1h.
Ethan (Support): running resend for PaperTrail and FathomMed now.
Bea (CS Ops): timeline & owners: Carlos - mitigation + root cause, Ethan - execute resends, Maya - customer outreach + renewal flagging, Bea - status page + exec summary. Check-ins every 20m.
Carlos (SE): applied batch throttle; queue drained from 450 -> 20 in 12m. Monitoring error rate and latency.
Ethan (Support): PaperTrail invites resent and accepted. FathomMed accepted after manual resend. GreenBridge accepts manual invites but asked for confirmation on SLA impact.
Maya (CSM): called GreenBridge tech lead, offered workshop and single-credit concession. They want an exec note; I'll loop in our account exec. Marking GreenBridge as at-risk for renewal outreach.
Bea (CS Ops): status page updated: "Investigating delayed onboarding invites; manual resend available; engineers applied temporary throttle. Updates every 30m." Posted.
Carlos (SE): starting postmortem draft under INC-2026-501. Initial hypothesis: batch size increase + spike in orgs with large member counts. Will own remediation and long-term fix (adaptive batching + queue autoscaler).
pagerbot: INCIDENT INC-2026-501 status -> monitoring, owner=@carlos_se.
Maya (CSM): capturing feedback: GreenBridge asked for clearer progress UI and an indicator when invites are queued vs sent. Creating product request PRD ticket: UX-1689.
Bea (CS Ops): recording comms in CS tracker: https://redwood.internal/cs/tracker/INC-2026-501. Closing thread after postmortem link and customer follow-ups are complete.
Ethan (Support): thanks team — will keep thread open until postmortem link posted.
Maya (CSM): will follow up with renewal playbook and update account health dashboard.
Carlos (SE): will post postmortem within 48h and assign follow-ups.
